Workload Group Z Resource Get Workload Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/workloadGroups

Retrieves the list of workload groups.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 250.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
description
string

The description of the workload group.

expression
string

The workload group expression consisting of tag types, tags, and their relationships.

expressionJson
object
id
int32

A unique identifier assigned to the workload group.

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp of when the workload group was last modified.

name
string

The name of the workload group.

]
